title: Integration queue: check-failure detail loses the failing test's name
body:
Symptom: when a project check fails, the integration object's detail (kanban list --json) shows only compiler warnings from cargo test. The FAILED / panicked lines never appear, so the worker can't tell which test failed. Card hzgzig lost two queue round trips to this and had to rerun the suite under CREATE_NO_WINDOW to find the test.

Cause: src/integrate.rs run_child appends stderr after stdout, then tail_lines keeps the last OUTPUT_TAIL_LINES (40). cargo test's test results go to stdout and its warnings to stderr, so the warnings fill the tail.

Fix direction: keep the lines that say why the check failed. For example, pull the FAILED / panicked / 'failures:' lines (plus a little context) out of the combined output ahead of the tail, or keep a tail of each stream separately with stdout's last. Do not grow the stored detail without a bound. Test with a fake check that prints a FAILED line to stdout and more than 40 warning lines to stderr, then assert the FAILED line survives into the detail.

Key code: run_child, tail_lines, OUTPUT_TAIL_LINES, and the Reason::CheckFailed resolve in the turn.
